name: POM121 transmembrane nucleoporin

function.text: POM121 is the approved symbol for POM121 transmembrane nucleoporin. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in structural constituent of nuclear pore; nucleocytoplasmic transport; protein import into nucleus.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Glioblastoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: POM121 encodes POM121 transmembrane nucleoporin. Its functions include structural constituent of nuclear pore and nucleocytoplasmic transport.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving POM121 have been reported in glioblastoma, cutaneous melanoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
